notes: Main disagreements: (1) phase, mostly general vs before-course/over-time/course-start/during-work for principles, faculty-use lists and sample syllabus statements; resolved by whether the passage names a point in the work (sample-statement rules governing student work coded during-work; standing principles coded general). (3) modality on the BOV 1220 statement list (should vs must; all six items coded should) and actor all vs admin for definitions and purpose.
